# Limit public API requests per key

This plan adds rate limits to the public API so one client can't slow it for everyone. It covers the limits, the response over the limit and the rollout.

## Limits

Each key gets 100 requests a minute.

Bursts of 20 are allowed.

The limits live in config.

# Limit public API requests per key

This plan adds rate limits to the public API so one client can't slow it for everyone. It covers the limits, the response over the limit and the rollout.

## Limits

Each API key gets 50 requests a minute; clients over the limit get 429 with Retry-After.

Bursts of 20 are allowed.

The limits live in config.

## Rollout

Turn the limits on for 10% of keys first.
